notes.title: Empty Bottle Gameplay Updatev1.7.5
notes.content:
General:
[list]
[*] Boto won`t die if other characters is pouring water into him.
[*] Fixed issues with Boto getting stuck when died during some conversition 
[*] The seesaw is much more easier to use. 
[*] Fixed issues that sometimes it is super hard to pour water into certain characters.
[*] FIxed a case where the sick cup did not react to Boto.
[*] One new sentence for Leaking. One new sentence for characters in the basement.


[*] 其他角色如果可以以某种方式立刻续上主角的水，则主角不会死。
[*] 解决了如果触发对话时主角死掉有时会导致角色卡住的问题。
[*] 跷跷板现在使用起来比以前流畅多了。
[*] 解决了给特定角色倒水非常困难的问题。
[*] 修复了一处会使病杯子和主角不再互动的问题。
[*] 添加了两句新台词。
[/list]
